serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Immersion Cloud has a fully complete security package ready for agency analysis.

 
Immersion Cloud delivers data analytics and visualization solutions for government users across mission areas like Financial Management, Human Resources, Asset Management, Payroll, Maintenance, Operations, Logistics, and Intelligence. Immersion Cloud leverages the Altair analytics suite of products built around RapidMiner as its core.  Federal clients upload data to the system or directly connect to existing data pipelines and repositories.  Since government customers are faced with a variety of legacy data formats, the Immersion Cloud RapidMiner can extract data from scanned PDF files, text files, and popular office automation suites.  Data is cataloged, exposed to authorized end-users, transformed to meet analytical needs, and accessed by models developed in RapidMiner.


The visual model-building interface allows rapid adoption by those without software development experience. More experienced coders can augment the visual tools to extend functionality, and it allows for re-use of analytical code already proven in the agency environment.  Recent updates to the core application set include the ability to implement machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) within the tool to identify otherwise hidden patterns.  The ML and AI analytical output can drive automated updates to more traditional models or offer stand-alone results.


Agency customers can use Immersion Cloud to cleanse data, reconcile ledgers, identify fraud patterns, reduce manual labor and associated costs, visualize results, and predict outcomes in a single, secure platform.
